title: Controller menu
summary: Editable local-player and controller settings UI.

blocks.text: Requires input.local-pilots, input.flight-profiles and input.flight-actions@1.0.0. input.gamepad@1.0.0 is optional: keyboard-controlled seats and saved profile editing work without a gamepad backend. Browser and offline only; platform authority.

Create a menu with a caller-owned root, configuration controller and pilot-name/open-state callbacks. The package owns its markup, style, capture listeners and animation loop. Close/dispose cancels capture; provider disposal closes every owned menu. It never steps a world or grants session ownership.

Preferences use the local-pilot/profile services and preserve existing storage migration. Missing gamepad support disables capture and live device diagnostics, rather than implying that connecting a physical pad can activate an absent module.

Unpack, edit source, rebuild/repack and import into a compatible game. Downloaded code requires explicit consent and has full application privileges. Building a package does not establish runtime acceptance.
